sources.title: Vultr: Details, Reviews, Pricing, & Features
sources.excerpt: Vultr provides Infrastructure-as-a-Service across 32 global data centers, offering virtual private servers, bare metal instances, and GPU computing starting at just $2.50/month—undercutting competitors by 28-50%. The company primarily serves developers and small-to-medium businesses deploying web applications, AI/ML workloads, and containerized infrastructure. Vultr differentiates through aggressive pricing paired with NVMe SSD infrastructure and flexible hourly billing, though user reviews [...] Vultr targets developers, startups, and small-to-medium businesses requiring flexible cloud infrastructure. Verified customers include Athos for AI therapeutics development and ImmunoPrecise Antibodies for computational biology research, indicating reach into emerging companies and research organizations. [...] Vultr's mission centers on making enterprise-grade infrastructure accessible to developers and businesses without the traditional enterprise overhead. The flexible hourly billing model and one-click application deployment address the gap between limited shared hosting and complex hyperscale cloud platforms.
